definitions.explanation: To cook food quickly in a small amount of oil over high heat while stirring.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎを{炒|いた}めてから{肉|にく}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Add the meat after sautéing the onions.

notes:
{炒|いた}める is an ichidan verb meaning to stir-fry or sauté.

HOMOPHONE WARNING:
- {炒|いた}める: to stir-fry (cooking)
- {傷|いた}める: to damage, hurt
Distinguished by kanji; context usually makes meaning clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜|やさい}を{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry vegetables
- {肉|にく}を{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry meat
- {強火|つよび}で{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry over high heat
- {油|あぶら}で{炒|いた}める: to fry in oil

COOKING VOCABULARY:
- {炒|いた}め{物|もの}: stir-fried dish
- {野菜|やさい}{炒|いた}め: vegetable stir-fry
- チャーハン/{炒飯|チャーハン}: fried rice

OTHER COOKING VERBS:
- {焼|や}く: to grill/bake
- {煮|に}る: to simmer/boil
- {揚|あ}げる: to deep-fry
- {蒸|む}す: to steam
